newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's B Band bid specs seen out Dec 30 - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's B Band bid specs seen out Dec 30 - report.

text.p: Communications Minister Sergio Motta said bid specifications for concessions to operate on the B Band cellular frequency will be published December 30, a local news agency reported.
Invest News also quoted Motta as saying the government will begin signing concession contracts on May 30, 1997.
Ministry officials could not confirm the report.

Twenty foreign-led groups are reported to be interested in bidding on the 10 B Band concessions the government intends to offer as it opens up Brazil's cellular sector to private capital for the first time.
The government hopes the privatization of the B Band will begin relieving the massive pent-up demand for cellular lines in the Brazilian market.
"Although we have never spent as much on telecommunications in this country (as we are now), demand is still greater than our capacity to meet it," Motta was quoted as saying.
The report did not say where Motta spoke.
